# recovery_subtask

*Part of the [beam4pm types reference](../beam4pm_types_reference.md). GENERATED by ggen_igniter -- do not edit.*

Declares a bounded recovery subtask for one failed or adverse outcome.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Doc |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subtask_id` | `string` | yes | Recovery subtask identity. |
| `trigger_outcome` | `string` | yes | Outcome that triggers recovery. |
| `recovery_goal_digest` | `string` | yes | Digest of the bounded recovery goal. |
